blocks.text: ARLINGTON, Texas — Arike Ogunbowale was standing near Paige Bueckers waiting for the star guard to make a move on her dribble with the Dallas Wings trailing by three as the final seconds of regulation — and their season — ticked away. Bueckers waved toward her backcourt mate, but she wasn’t telling Ogunbowale to get out of the way. She was telling her to get open.
